verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI privacy documentation states its AI features are opt-in and neither Graphite nor its subprocessors train on customer data, with contractual prohibitions on its Anthropic and OpenAI subprocessors. Organizations can also request a complete block of all AI features via support, so customer data is protected by default without user action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training commitment.
